nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: TTL-based SQLite cache for Linear GraphQL metadata (projects/teams/issues/workflow states) keyed by connection+scope+scope_id, with async read/write helpers, per-scope/per-record invalidation, and row-count pruning.

nodes.name: LinearCacheScope
nodes.summary: Enum of the Linear metadata cache scopes (Projects/Project/Teams/ProjectIssues/WorkflowStates) used as a cache-key discriminator.

nodes.name: root_scope_id
nodes.summary: Resolves the cache scope_id to a pagination cursor or the sentinel 'root' id when no cursor is given.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Async cache lookup that returns None on force_refresh, otherwise queries linear_metadata_cache for a non-expired row and deserializes its JSON payload off the async runtime via spawn_blocking.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Async cache upsert that serializes a value, inserts/updates its row in linear_metadata_cache with a TTL-based expiry, and triggers pruning of expired/excess rows.

nodes.name: invalidate_scope
nodes.summary: Deletes all cached rows for a given connection+scope, used to force a refetch after mutations affecting an entire scope.

nodes.name: invalidate_record
nodes.summary: Deletes a single cached row identified by connection+scope+scope_id, used to force a refetch of one record after a targeted mutation.

nodes.name: prune
nodes.summary: Removes expired cache rows and, if the table still exceeds the row cap, trims the oldest rows by fetched_at to enforce LINEAR_METADATA_CACHE_MAX_ROWS.

nodes.name: queries.rs
nodes.summary: Static GraphQL query/mutation string constants (projects, single project, teams, workflow states, issues, plus create/update mutations) used by the native Linear API client to fetch and mutate project-management data.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Serde data-transfer types mirroring Linear's GraphQL schema: read-model summaries (projects, teams, issues, workflow states, labels, users) and create/update request payloads used by the native Linear sync client.

nodes.name: LinearPageInfo
nodes.summary: GraphQL pagination cursor info (has_next_page, end_cursor) shared by all paginated Linear list results.

nodes.name: LinearUserSummary
nodes.summary: Minimal Linear user reference (id, name, email) used for lead/assignee fields.

nodes.name: LinearTeamSummary
nodes.summary: Minimal Linear team reference (id, name, key).

nodes.name: LinearLabelSummary
nodes.summary: Minimal Linear issue label reference (id, name, color).

nodes.name: LinearProjectStatusType
nodes.summary: Enum of Linear project statuses (Backlog/Planned/Started/Completed/Canceled) with a snake_case wire mapping and a from_linear_value parser.

nodes.name: LinearProjectStatusSummary
nodes.summary: Linear project status reference combining id, name, typed status, and display color.

nodes.name: LinearProjectSummary
nodes.summary: Full read-model of a Linear project including status, lead, teams, and lifecycle dates, returned by project list/detail queries.

nodes.name: LinearProjectListResult
nodes.summary: Paginated list of LinearProjectSummary with page_info for cursor-based pagination.

nodes.name: LinearTeamListResult
nodes.summary: Paginated list of LinearTeamSummary with page_info for cursor-based pagination.

nodes.name: LinearWorkflowStateType
nodes.summary: Enum of Linear workflow-state types (Backlog/Unstarted/Started/Completed/Canceled) with a snake_case wire mapping and a from_linear_value parser.

nodes.name: LinearWorkflowStateSummary
nodes.summary: Read-model of a Linear workflow state including its type, color, board position, archival timestamp, and owning team.

nodes.name: LinearWorkflowStateListResult
nodes.summary: Paginated list of LinearWorkflowStateSummary with page_info.

nodes.name: LinearIssueSummary
nodes.summary: Full read-model of a Linear issue including state, assignee, project, team, and labels, returned by issue list/detail queries.

nodes.name: LinearIssueState
nodes.summary: Minimal Linear issue workflow-state reference (id, name, type) embedded in issue summaries.

nodes.name: LinearProjectRef
nodes.summary: Minimal Linear project reference (id, name) embedded in issue summaries.

nodes.name: LinearIssueListResult
nodes.summary: Paginated list of LinearIssueSummary with page_info.

nodes.name: LinearProjectCreateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for creating a Linear project, with optional description/team_ids/lead/date fields defaulted when omitted.

nodes.name: LinearProjectUpdateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for patching a Linear project, using nested Option<Option<T>> to distinguish 'omit field' from 'set field to null'.

nodes.name: LinearWorkflowStateCreateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for creating a Linear workflow state under a team, with optional description/color/type/position.

nodes.name: LinearWorkflowStateUpdateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for patching a Linear workflow state's name/description/color/type/position.

nodes.name: LinearIssueCreateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for creating a Linear issue with required title/team/project and optional description/priority/estimate/state.

nodes.name: LinearIssueUpdateRequest
nodes.summary: Deserialized request payload for patching a Linear issue's title/description/priority/estimate/state.

nodes.name: linear_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Wiremock-backed unit tests for the Linear OAuth helper (start_auth_flow, await_callback, exchange_code, refresh), covering PKCE derivation, authorize-URL construction, callback state matching/timeout/cancellation/denial, and token exchange/refresh error paths.

nodes.name: start_auth_flow_builds_pkce_compliant_authorize_url
nodes.summary: Asserts start_auth_flow produces an authorize URL with the expected PKCE challenge, state, and redirect parameters.

nodes.name: await_callback_resolves_with_code_on_state_match
nodes.summary: Asserts await_callback resolves with the authorization code once a callback request with the matching state param arrives.

nodes.name: await_callback_returns_state_mismatch_when_state_differs
nodes.summary: Asserts await_callback returns a state-mismatch error when the callback's state parameter differs from the one issued.

nodes.name: await_callback_times_out_when_no_callback_arrives
nodes.summary: Asserts await_callback times out and returns an error when no OAuth callback request arrives within the deadline.

nodes.name: await_callback_returns_cancelled_when_token_signalled
nodes.summary: Asserts await_callback returns a cancelled result when an external cancellation token is signalled before the callback arrives.

nodes.name: await_callback_returns_access_denied_on_authorize_error
nodes.summary: Asserts await_callback surfaces an access-denied error when the callback request carries an OAuth error query parameter.

nodes.name: exchange_code_returns_token_record_with_refresh_and_expiry
nodes.summary: Asserts exchange_code trades an authorization code for a token record populated with access/refresh tokens and a computed expiry.

nodes.name: exchange_code_surfaces_http_error_through_poll_failed
nodes.summary: Asserts exchange_code surfaces the token endpoint's HTTP error response as a poll-failed error.

nodes.name: refresh_returns_fresh_record_with_new_expiry
nodes.summary: Asserts refresh exchanges a refresh token for a new token record with an updated expiry.

nodes.name: refresh_returns_error_string_on_revoked_token
nodes.summary: Asserts refresh surfaces an error string when the token endpoint reports the refresh token has been revoked.

nodes.name: test_token_endpoint_override_round_trips
nodes.summary: Asserts the Linear token-endpoint URL override env var is respected end-to-end when exchanging a code for a token.

nodes.name: debug.rs
nodes.summary: Debug-only entry point for e2e sync test harnesses that resets backoff state on a project's pending outbox rows and drives one push cycle synchronously.

nodes.name: pump_once_for_project
nodes.summary: Resets last_attempted_at to NULL for every Pending outbox row owned by the given project slug, then drives one push cycle up to the standard tick cap, for use by e2e test harnesses.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the search crate, pulling in ripgrep-core (grep-searcher/grep-regex), tree-sitter grammars for TS/JS/Python/Rust symbol indexing, nucleo fuzzy matching, and blake3 for workspace merkle-tree caching.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the session-persistence crate, depending on agent_core, database, core_types, and orgtrack_core to back its Tauri commands and rusqlite-backed persistence layer.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the settings crate, a small Tauri-integrated crate using the notify filesystem-watcher and serde_json for reading/watching app settings.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the shared-state crate, depending on app_paths/app_platform plus tokio and uuid, with a unix-only target-specific dependency block.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the system-services crate, wiring Tauri notifications, app_window/app_platform/git/integrations workspace crates, and platform-specific (unix/macos/windows) dependency blocks for OS-level services like workspace port scanning.

nodes.name: advertised_urls_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for advertised dev-server URL ingestion, covering http(s) origin parsing/change detection, rejection of non-http schemes, and trailing-punctuation stripping.

nodes.name: ingests_http_origin_and_reports_change
nodes.summary: Asserts ingest_advertised_url parses an http origin, reports a change on first ingest vs. no change on a repeat, and that lookup_advertised_url returns the cached origin.

nodes.name: scanner_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the workspace port scanner's platform-specific listening-port parsers (lsof, netstat, /proc/net/tcp) and container-process-name detection, plus a timeout test for the run_command helper.

nodes.name: parses_lsof_pcn_output
nodes.summary: Asserts parse_lsof_listening_output correctly parses macOS lsof -P -i -n output into per-process listening-port entries.

nodes.name: parses_netstat_listening_rows
nodes.summary: Asserts the netstat output parser extracts listening ports and process names on platforms that expose netstat.

nodes.name: parses_proc_net_tcp_listen_rows
nodes.summary: Asserts the /proc/net/tcp parser extracts listening ports from Linux's hex-encoded socket table.

nodes.name: detects_container_process_names
nodes.summary: Asserts the scanner recognizes container-runtime process names (e.g. docker-proxy) when classifying listening ports.
